q: How long does a GHG verification take for a small company?
title: How long a GHG verification takes
short: For a single-site MSME with organised records, often a few weeks from contract to statement: planning, document review, a site visit of a day or two, then questions and the report. Most delay comes from slow answers to the verifier's queries, not the verifier's own work.
audience: MSMEs planning a verification for a buyer or lender deadline

ol: Agreement on scope, criteria and level of assurance.
Document review and a sampling plan.

ul: A complete inventory with methods written down.
Invoices and logbooks filed by month.
One person who can answer queries quickly.

p: If a buyer needs the statement by a date, start at least two months earlier so a round of corrections does not miss it.

senseible: Senseible keeps every figure linked to its source invoice or bill with a fingerprint, so a verifier can trace a total back to the documents it came from.
